_que_es: Unidades de la receta SearchAndDig (lo que se encuentra cavando), 2026-11-02. Referencia de estilo: skills/_shared/iconos/referencia-estilo.png.

ia.prompt: Nine glossy toy-like objects, in this order: 1) old_boot: an old brown boot with a hole and a little worm peeking out, 2) rubber_duck: a yellow rubber duck, 3) toy_robot: a small silver toy robot with a red antenna, 4) pearl: a white pearl inside an open pink seashell, 5) gold_ring: a gold ring with a big blue gem, 6) ancient_coin: an ancient golden coin with a star emblem, 7) magic_crystal: a glowing purple magic crystal cluster, 8) golden_needle: a shiny golden sewing needle with sparkles, 9) rainbow_needle: a glowing rainbow sewing needle with stars around it.
